description: Implementation of file utility functions for file operations such as open checks, recursive delete, read, write, and logging within the starboard namespace.

methods.name: DirectoryCloseLogFailure
methods.description: Closes a directory and logs an error if closing fails.

methods.name: FileCanOpen
methods.description: Checks if a file can be opened with specified flags.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a file descriptor is valid (non-negative).

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads the specified amount of data from a file descriptor.

methods.name: RecordFileWriteStat
methods.description: Records the result of a file write operation to metrics tracker.

methods.name: SbFileDeleteRecursive
methods.description: Recursively deletes files and directories at a given path.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes the specified data to a file descriptor.
